texts.facts: Consequently, the matter was directed to be registered as a public interest litigation.
texts.arguments: 4. Learned counsel representing the Union of India as also the Delhi Police has stated that certain offences have been registered and criminal action is also being taken. He further states on instructions that investigation in certain matters are at the verge of the completion and soon it is likely that the charge-sheet may be filed. 5. By the next date of listing, an affidavit on behalf of Delhi Police shall also be filed stating therein the action which might have been taken or which may be taken at their end in the matter. 6. Learned counsel representing the Government of National Capital Territory of Delhi has submitted on instructions that the officers of Delhi Government entrusted with certain tasks under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, and they have been taking appropriate action wherever the same has been found necessary. 7. Learned counsel representing the Delhi Government shall also file an affidavit bringing on record the details of the permissible action taken under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 for violation of the provisions concerning the issues involved in the present writ petition by the next date of listing.
